title: PipelineContextDetailsResponse
description: GET /api/pipelines/context-details response body (HEL-1619): one item per pipeline `GET /api/pipelines` returns for the same caller (owner-scoped, same order). Each item carries that pipeline's steps -- the same elements `GET /api/pipelines/:id/steps` returns -- and, when the pipeline has at least one persisted run, the latest run's assertion summary (the same value as `GET /api/pipelines/:id/run-history`'s first entry's `assertions`). `latestRunAssertions` is OMITTED (not null) for a never-run pipeline, so it is not in `required`. helio-mcp's `get_workspace_context` reads this instead of three requests per pipeline; `additionalProperties: false` so a renamed key fails validation on both the backend and the MCP test.

PipelineStep.description: One element of `GET /api/pipelines/:id/steps`. `config`'s shape depends on `type`; `parentStepId` and `rootId` are omitted when absent (spray-json drops `Option = None`).
